newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: NAB SEES ROE AROUND 15 PCT LONG TERM.
newsitem.headline: NAB SEES ROE AROUND 15 PCT LONG TERM.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd (NAB) managing director Don Argus said on Monday the bank saw a return on equity target of about 15 percent as sustainable over the longer term.

Argus said NAB had achieved return on equity figures of about 17 percent recently, but low inflation and moderate credit growth meant a lower return on equity was more likely and achievable over the long term. "We see a long-term sustainable figure of around the 15 percent mark," Argus told a Securities Institute of Australia luncheon in Sydney.
